result.instructions: Tools for ROLLER, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which bookings do we have on Saturday, and how many guests are booked in?"; "Is the Birthday Party product available on 14 March, and how many spots are left?"; "Show yesterday's payments and revenue entries.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ROLLER data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run roller_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run roller_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run roller_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. roller_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: roller_get_venue
tools.title: Get venue
tools.description: Get the venue the API key belongs to: name, time zone, currency, country, taxes, fees and venue groups. Read only.

tools.name: roller_search_bookings
tools.title: Search bookings
tools.description: Search the 100 most recent bookings by keywords (name, ticket id, guest name, email or phone), by booking date, by session start time, by product ids or by resource ids. At least one filter is required. Product ids and resource ids need a date. Read only.

keywords.description: Search text, at least 3 characters: booking name, ticket id, guest first name, last name, email or phone.

date.description: Booking date of the booking items, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

startTime.description: Session start time, 24 hour HH:MM (session products only).

productIds.description: Comma-separated product ids. A date is required.

locationIds.description: Comma-separated resource ids (formerly location ids). A date is required.

tools.name: roller_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: Get one booking: status, guest, items, tickets, modifiers, totals and payments. Read only.

bookingId.description: The booking unique id (UUID) or the ROLLER booking reference number.

includeDiscounts.description: true: also list the discount codes applied to the booking.

tools.name: roller_get_booking_form_responses
tools.title: Get booking form responses
tools.description: Get the form questions and answers captured on a booking. Read only.

bookingId.description: The booking unique id (UUID) or the ROLLER booking reference number.

tools.name: roller_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get a company profile of the venue: contact, address, tax and registration numbers. Read only.

companyId.description: The company id, for example from a booking's companyId.

tools.name: roller_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products of the venue with prices, dates and settings. The data changes rarely: ask for it sparingly. Read only.

productCategory.description: Only products in this product category.

productType.description: Only this product type, for example pass or membership.

tools.name: roller_get_product_availability
tools.title: Get product availability
tools.description: Get the products that are available on one date, with capacity and session times. Read only.

date.description: The date to check, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

productCategory.description: Only products in this product category.

productIds.description: Only these parent product ids, comma-separated.

tools.name: roller_get_product_availability_calendar
tools.title: Get product availability calendar
tools.description: Get the availability status of each day of one month for one product: available, filling, soldOut, notAvailable or onlineSalesClosed. Read only.

month.description: The month, as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-03.

tools.name: roller_get_price_rules
tools.title: Get price rules
tools.description: List the active time-based price rules of the venue: the price tiers and when each tier applies. Read only.

tools.name: roller_list_segments
tools.title: List guest segments
tools.description: List the guest segments set up for the venue (id and name). Read only.

tools.name: roller_get_guest
tools.title: Get guest
tools.description: Get one guest record: name, email, phone, address, marketing consent and flags. Read only.

guestId.description: The guest id (the customerId of a booking).

tools.name: roller_get_guest_multi_passes
tools.title: Get guest multi-passes
tools.description: Get the multi-pass balances of one guest: uses remaining, expiry and exhaustion status. Read only.

guestId.description: The guest id (the customerId of a booking).

tools.name: roller_get_signed_waiver
tools.title: Get signed waiver
tools.description: Get one waiver signed by a guest: signer, validity and dates. Read only.

tools.name: roller_get_signed_waiver_form_responses
tools.title: Get signed waiver form responses
tools.description: Get the form questions and answers captured on a signed waiver. Read only.

tools.name: roller_get_discount
tools.title: Get discount
tools.description: Get one discount configuration: amount or percent off, products, channels, dates and usage limit. Read only.

tools.name: roller_list_modifier_groups
tools.title: List modifier groups
tools.description: List the modifier groups of the venue with their modifiers. Filter by group name text or by a stock product. Read only.

keywords.description: Only groups whose name contains this text.

productId.description: Only groups linked to this stock product id.

tools.name: roller_get_modifier_group
tools.title: Get modifier group
tools.description: Get one modifier group with its modifiers and linked products. Read only.

tools.name: roller_get_gift_card_balance
tools.title: Get gift card balance
tools.description: Get the balance, initial value and expiry date of a gift card by its number. This sends a read request and changes nothing. Read only.

tools.name: roller_report_bookings
tools.title: Report bookings
tools.description: List the bookings and their items whose booking was created or modified on one day (the filter is the booking modified date). Reporting API: one day per call (the daily batch export). Not for real-time use. Read only.

date.description: The day to read, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

tools.name: roller_report_tickets
tools.title: Report tickets
tools.description: List the tickets (passes, session passes, recurring passes and memberships) of bookings that were created or modified on one day (the filter is the booking modified date, not the ticket date). Reporting API: one day per call (the daily batch export). Not for real-time use. Read only.

date.description: The day to read, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

tools.name: roller_report_gift_cards
tools.title: Report gift cards
tools.description: List the gift cards created or modified on one day (the filter is the modified date). Reporting API: one day per call (the daily batch export). Not for real-time use. Read only.

date.description: The day to read, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

tools.name: roller_report_guests

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

date.description: The day to read, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

tools.name: roller_report_signed_waivers

tools.description: List the signed waiver records created or modified on one day (the filter is the modified date, so an older waiver can appear when it changes). Reporting API: one day per call (the daily batch export). Not for real-time use. Read only.

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

tools.description: List which signed waivers belong to which bookings and tickets, for records created or modified on one day (the filter is the modified date). Reporting API: one day per call (the daily batch export). Not for real-time use. Read only.

date.description: The day to read, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

tools.name: roller_report_payments
tools.title: Report payments
tools.description: List the payments made against bookings on one day. Reporting API: one day per call (the daily batch export). Not for real-time use. Read only.

tools.name: roller_report_revenue_entries
tools.title: Report revenue entries
tools.description: List the revenue entries of one day (funds received and recognised revenue, by entry date). The page size is fixed at 100 by ROLLER. Reporting API: one day per call (the daily batch export). Not for real-time use. Read only.

date.description: The day to read, as YYYY-MM-DD (venue local date), for example 2026-03-14.

localTimes.description: true: return date-times in the venue time zone with an offset. Default: UTC.

bookingReferences.description: Only these bookings: up to 100 comma-separated booking references.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ROLLER
prompts.description: What you can do with ROLLER here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_the_bookings_for_a_day_or_a_guest
prompts.title: Find the bookings for a day or a guest
prompts.description: Search the 100 most recent bookings by guest name, email, phone or booking date. Open one booking to see its tickets, items and payments.

prompts.name: check_what_is_available_on_a_date
prompts.title: Check what is available on a date
prompts.description: List the products of the venue, then check which ones have capacity and session times on one date. Use the monthly calendar to see which days are sold out.

prompts.name: review_yesterday_s_payments_and_revenue
prompts.title: Review yesterday's payments and revenue
prompts.description: Read the payments and revenue entries recorded on one venue day. Each call covers one day only.

prompts.name: check_a_guest_s_form_answers_and_multi_pass_balance
prompts.title: Check a guest's form answers and multi-pass balance
prompts.description: Read the form answers captured on a booking. Open a guest record to see its details and the uses left on their multi-passes.

prompts.name: check_a_signed_waiver_before_a_session
prompts.title: Check a signed waiver before a session
prompts.description: Open a signed waiver to see who signed it, whether it is still valid and its dates. Read the form answers it holds.

prompts.name: check_a_gift_card_balance
prompts.title: Check a gift card balance
prompts.description: Enter a gift card number to read its balance, initial value and expiry date. The check changes nothing in ROLLER.
